_published_faq.name: How do I add Fryd - Your Gardening Companion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fryd - Your Gardening Companion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fryd.app/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Fryd - Your Gardening Companion MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Fryd - Your Gardening Companion scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fryd - Your Gardening Companion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fryd - Your Gardening Companion provides these MCP tools: check_companion_planting, get_plant_profile, get_seasonal_calendar, search_crops, and search_planting_plans.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fryd - Your Gardening Companion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fryd - Your Gardening Companion in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and API Lessons.

_published_faq.name: Does Fryd - Your Gardening Companion MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fryd - Your Gardening Companion does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Fryd - Your Gardening Companion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fryd - Your Gardening Companion is developed by Fryd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
